Over the past several years,

the Sustainability & Impact

team at Rockefeller & Co. has implemented active stewardship with the financial services sector.
On behalf of our clients, we have engaged with boards of directors and senior management, focusing on the following issues:

¢ Implementing strategy on long-term financial stability

¢ Improving transparency over business standards, values and culture

¢ Establishing sound risk management systems and processes

e Compensation and incentive programs tied to long-term performance

¢ Implementing new employee engagement and trainings

e Sustainable finance and climate related investments

e Financial inclusion and access to underserved populations
